steps.title: Gear box: bearing and first walls
Vertical drive axle with 24-tooth gear
steps.note: Push the 16L axle down until it touches the base plate; it will rise 16 studs above the gear box.

steps.title: Support columns under the pond floor
Pond floor
steps.note: The Technic plate goes over the drive axle; the axle passes through its centre hole.

steps.title: Water
steps.note: Leave the 4 x 4 area in the middle open for the pillar.

steps.title: Stud islands for trees and lanterns
The single stone pillar
steps.note: Slide each round brick down over the drive axle.

steps.title: Capital on top of the pillar
Capital on top of the pillar
Lotus-petal struts
steps.note: Four straight struts and four corner struts spring from the capital.

steps.title: Platform of Liên Hoa Đài
steps.note: The Technic plate in the centre lets the drive axle through.

steps.title: Shrine floor
steps.note: The round tile with a hole is the bearing for the rotating lotus throne.

steps.title: Place the statue on the drive axle
steps.note: Press the round plate onto the axle so the statue turns when the crank is turned.

steps.title: Front wall and door
steps.note: The door opens inwards; turn the crank to make Quan Âm face the door.

steps.title: Roof frame
steps.note: The roof is a separate module that lifts off to show the statue.

steps.title: Gable
steps.note: Hip-and-gable roof: the upper part closes with small gables on the left and right.

steps.title: Two dragons facing the moon
steps.note: Lưỡng long chầu nguyệt: each dragon curls its tail at the end of the ridge and raises its head toward the pearl moon.

steps.title: Place the roof on the shrine
